applications.message: I have 3 years of logo design experience and a strong portfolio of university club branding. I would love to help make your CS club stand out!
While my main focus is development, I have a solid eye for design and have created logos for 2 campus orgs. Happy to share samples.
I am a senior CS student experienced in React and Redux. I have built 3 dashboard-style applications and can start immediately.
React is my primary stack. I built a student planner app as a side project — it includes calendar and task features similar to what you need.
I have written two business plans before for entrepreneurship class and both received top marks. I can deliver a thorough and compelling document.
As an Econ student I can write solid market analysis and financial projections. I am great at data-driven business storytelling.
Python data analysis is my specialty. I work with pandas, matplotlib, and seaborn daily. I can handle your CSV and have it done within 3 days.
I have done similar data processing tasks for academic projects. I am comfortable with pandas and can create clear visualizations quickly.
I have written numerous biology and science lab reports. I am familiar with APA format and can ensure your reports are clear, accurate, and well-structured.
I have experience writing technical and scientific documents. I can help with the data interpretation and structuring sections especially.
Statistics is core to data science. I am proficient in both R and Python for statistical analysis and can walk you through the methods as we work.
I took advanced econometrics and use R regularly for regression and ANOVA analysis. I can help interpret results in plain language for your research paper.
I am an English senior who has helped 10+ friends edit their grad school personal statements with a strong success rate. I would love to help you shine on paper.
Strong communicator here. I have reviewed personal statements for MBA programs and can apply similar principles to CS grad school applications.
I have experience writing event marketing copy and have managed social campaigns for two student clubs. Excited to support the hackathon!
Illustration is my passion! I have created editorial illustrations for 3 university publications and have a strong scientific illustration style.
I specialize in digital illustration and have done nature-themed pieces for academic projects. Portfolio available on request.
I have built financial data scripts using yfinance and pandas. I can automate the PDF report generation using ReportLab. Ready to start.
I have strong writing and research skills and can create engaging, well-researched podcast scripts on campus life and sustainability topics.
I have experience with Plotly and Dash and have built interactive dashboards before. Gene expression data visualization sounds like a great project!
I can teach you GitHub in just two days.

reviews.comment: Jordan delivered an outstanding marketing strategy. The social media plan was creative and the email drafts were perfectly on-brand. Highly recommend!
Riley was a great client — very clear in their requirements and provided all necessary info promptly. Payment was fast. Would work with them again!
Morgan's illustration was absolutely stunning! Captured the biodiversity theme perfectly with a fresh modern style. Delivered 2 days early.
Taylor gave helpful feedback during the revision rounds. Could have been a bit more specific with initial requirements but overall a pleasant collaboration.
Alex built exactly what I needed. The PDF reports were clean and the script runs perfectly. Excellent communication throughout. 10/10!
Drew had a clear vision and gave me the dataset quickly. A few spec changes mid-project but handled them well. Good experience overall.
Alex built an incredible Plotly dashboard. The filters and export features worked flawlessly. The lab team was very impressed. Will hire again!
Riley wrote well-researched and engaging scripts. Needed minor edits but the structure and tone were spot-on. Great collaborator!
